metadata.title: W012 Schema-Grounded Legacy Pilot Lineage Remediation Redesign
metadata.final_verdict: DESIGN COMPLETE — READY FOR CTO REMEDIATION AUTHORIZATION

blocker_1_is_canonical.evidence: Migration 039 (line 168) explicitly created public.record_provenance_linkages with 'is_canonical BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true'. Live staging OpenAPI schema and PostgreSQL catalog confirm property 'is_canonical' exists with format boolean and default true. It is indexed via idx_record_provenance_lookup(domain_table, domain_record_id, is_canonical).
blocker_1_is_canonical.resolution: No schema modification needed. is_canonical is a native, pre-existing primitive of W012.

blocker_2_dataset_versions_immutability.evidence: Migration 039 trigger trg_prevent_dataset_version_mutation (lines 231-245) strictly blocks updates to id, dataset_id, version_tag, effective_from, effective_to, retrieved_at, record_count, checksum_sha256, storage_path, metadata, created_at with exception 'IMMUTABILITY VIOLATION: Historical dataset version snapshots cannot be modified in place. Register a new version snapshot instead.'
blocker_2_dataset_versions_immutability.resolution: Zero UPDATE statements will be executed against dataset_versions. ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1 remains completely untouched as an immutable historical snapshot. Supersession is represented purely at the provenance DAG level and in the incoming official dataset version ts_lgd_mandals_2026_v1.

Q1_is_canonical_exists.evidence: Migration 039 line 168; verified live on panIN-staging via PostgREST OpenAPI schema and catalog query.

Q2_canonical_distinction_mechanism.answer: record_provenance_linkages.is_canonical (true for canonical active links, false for historical/superseded pilot links), combined with provenance_records DAG parent_provenance_id and transformation_type.

Q3_provenance_records_insertion.answer: YES, 100% compliant. transformation_type is unconstrained TEXT, and parent_provenance_id is a valid self-referential FK. prevent_provenance_mutation only blocks UPDATE/DELETE, not INSERT.

Q4_supersession_dataset_version.answer: ts_lgd_mandals_2026_v1 (the active authoritative dataset establishing the canonical identities), with parent_provenance_id pointing back to the pilot nodes in ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1.

Q5_dataset_version_supersession_without_.answer: YES. In W012, dataset versions are immutable snapshots. Supersession is modeled by registering the incoming official version (ts_lgd_mandals_2026_v1) and connecting provenance nodes across versions via parent_provenance_id. Zero updates to ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1 are required.

Q6_status_metadata_convention.answer: Incoming dataset versions document supersession in metadata (e.g. metadata->>'supersedes'). Old versions remain UNVERIFIED or are left untouched in their historical state.

Q7_status_change_evidence_requirement.answer: Elevating status to OFFICIAL requires authoritative evidence_records (Migration 039 line 271). Transitioning to DEPRECATED does not, but to respect snapshot immutability, ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1 default_status is left UNCHANGED (UNVERIFIED) with zero DML.

Q8_legacy_records_represented_exclusivel.answer: YES. record_provenance_linkages has no FK to public.mandals (polymorphic loose string domain_record_id). Legacy pilot IDs can remain in record_provenance_linkages with is_canonical = false while public.mandals contains strictly the 621 canonical statutory entities.

Q9_geography_entity_lineage_metadata_rep.answer: Update row 68e465c2-a00b-478d-8082-e0cf1f3bbe67: update predecessor_internal_id and successor_internal_id to canonical UUIDs (md5('mandals:TS-MDL-4354')::uuid and md5('mandals:TS-MDL-6227')::uuid); merge metadata to store canonical IDs while preserving legacy pilot IDs as audit history in metadata->'legacy_pilot_ids'.

Q10_exact_provenance_dag.structure: Pilot Node (ts_lgd_mandals_2023_v1, status UNVERIFIED) -> Parent of -> Supersession Node (ts_lgd_mandals_2026_v1, status OFFICIAL, transformation_type 'identity_superseded_by_canonical') -> Canonical Linkage (is_canonical = true, domain_record_id = TS-MDL-canonical). Historical linkage to TS-MDL-pilot updated to is_canonical = false.

proof_perspectives.current_state: All 621 rows are active with valid current_version_id pointers and 0 nulls.
proof_perspectives.stable_identity_architecture: TS-MDL-<inception_code> uniquely maps to physical administrative units; the 12 pilot units already exist under canonical codes.
proof_perspectives.production_provenance: Production never executed Migration 042; keeping 633 on staging creates permanent production drift.
proof_perspectives.w014_semantics: Keeping 12 pilot anchors with null current_version_id violates W014; binding them to canonical versions violates fn_guard_mandal_current_version cross-mandal checks.
proof_perspectives.absence_of_statutory_entities: The 12 pilot IDs do not represent separate or dissolved entities; they are synthetic labels for continuing mandals.
